verdict.rationale: The evidence shows code that can be viewed and edited inside Make, plus generated Payload/Next.js code included in the Make project. That is in-platform code access, not a documented way to export the full source or run and host the app elsewhere. Publishing is documented only to Figma's hosted infrastructure, and community reports describe having to reverse-engineer the undocumented .make binary to extract the React code, which indicates there is no official export path.

support.subject: As a developer, I can export the full source code and run or host the app outside the platform
